# --default-symver does not work with lto, which fuzz introspector uses.
if [ "$SANITIZER" == "introspector" ]; then
  sed -i 's/--default-symver/-flto/g' ./configure.ac
fi
# Run the OSS-Fuzz script in the project.
./test/ossfuzz/ossfuzz.sh

if USE_OSSFUZZERS
noinst_PROGRAMS += \
	json_load_dump_fuzzer \
	json_pack_unpack_fuzzer

noinst_LIBRARIES += \
	libstandaloneengine.a
endif

json_load_dump_fuzzer_SOURCES = json_load_dump_fuzzer.cc testinput.h
json_load_dump_fuzzer_CXXFLAGS = $(AM_CXXFLAGS) $(FUZZ_FLAG)
json_load_dump_fuzzer_LDFLAGS = $(AM_LDFLAGS) -static
dependency_reason: Defines the target that the delegated build may select.
parse_json delegates value construction to the unsupplied parse_value body.
json_loadb closes its lexer after parsing.
The callback dump closes its parent set.
json_dumps closes its string buffer and returns the result for the entry to free.
json_decref releases a non-singleton value when its reference count reaches zero.
Both dump modes reach do_dump with depth zero after the root-type guard.
do_dump rejects values when its depth reaches the limit.
